reason: Corrected v2 preserved non-override gains but regressed the observable intent-override scenario, so test exactly one mechanism-specific fallback without changing either ranker.

single_candidate.guard: Route to the matched base model when ConversationState contains an inactive value whose invalidated_reason is global_override, earlier_preference_override, category_override, or override_replacement. Do not use scenario, target, profile, future, or hidden fields.
single_candidate.guard_persistence: Once an observable override invalidation exists in current session state, use the base route for that and subsequent turns.

frozen_evaluation.model_reuse: Within every fold, fit the base and corrected constraint models once using the frozen procedure, then evaluate unguarded and guarded routes with those same model objects.
required_reports: Hit@10, MRR, MTTC, and technical score
paired bootstrap interval and randomization p-value
exact routed turn/session counts and reasons

stop_rule: If this single observable guard fails any gate, stop constraint-aware GBDT search. Do not add another guard, threshold, feature, or route.
